package.name: bonbon_ai_runtime
package.description: Pluggable vision-model inference runtime abstraction: CPU/ONNX, TensorRT, Hailo AI HAT, and mock, behind one VisionModelRuntimeInterface with an auto-selecting RuntimeSelector. Lets bonbon_vision run YOLO on the Raspberry Pi AI HAT (Hailo) when present and fall back to CPU otherwise. Hailo is OPTIONAL: every heavy backend is lazy-imported, so this package imports and its tests pass on a plain dev machine with no accelerator.
